text: Non-Chinese citizens with good physical and mental healthHave certain economic capacity; No criminal recordApplicants who have one of the following circumstances must hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for at least 4 years, and have resided abroad for at least 2 years in the past 4 years (before April 30 of the enrollment year) before submitting their application as an international student: （1）Born in Chinese Mainland, Hong Kong, Macao or Taiwan, and acquired foreign nationality （2）If bothparents (or one of them) are Chinese citizens and reside in a foreign country, the applicant himself/herself has foreign nationality from the time of birth.Age Range of Applicants ：Scholarship application: 16 to 28 years old ；Self-funded study: 16 to 35 years oldEducation background: High school graduate or equivalentLanguage Level needed for applicants：Chinese-taught programs: HSKLevel 4 (180 points) or above ；English-taught programs: IELTS (academic) 5.5 or TOEFL IBT 72 or above
